hero.title: About AnyRide
hero.subtitle: Moving people and livelihoods safely, locally, reliably.
hero.description: AnyRide connects riders with verified drivers using both cars and motorcycles. Built for everyday movement commuting, errands, short trips with a focus on safety, fairness, and local realities.

whatWeDo.title: What is AnyRide?
whatWeDo.description: AnyRide is more than just another ride-hailing app — it's a movement built around freedom, trust, and everyday convenience. We started AnyRide with one simple goal: to make movement across cities easier, safer, and more rewarding for everyone — whether you're catching a quick ride or earning behind the wheel. We understand what it means to hustle, to move, and to make things happen — that's why AnyRide was created to serve real people with real needs. Our platform connects riders and drivers in seconds, helping both sides save time, earn more, and move confidently through their day.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.subtitle: The vision is to go global
vision.description: To build Africa's most trusted local mobility network — one that puts people, not just technology, at the center. We're not just creating rides; we're building bridges between people, opportunities, and safer streets.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.subtitle: We are here just for you
mission.description: To redefine local transportation by making every trip effortless, affordable, and empowering — for both riders and drivers. We believe that movement should never be stressful, unsafe, or overpriced. Everyone deserves a ride that's fair, transparent, and easy to trust.

bothModes.title: Why both
bothModes.subtitle: Cars and motorcycles aren't competing — they're complementary.
bothModes.description: In many cities, motorcycles are not an alternative — they're essential. AnyRide supports both, giving riders choice and drivers opportunity.

drivers.title: Drivers
drivers.description: We see the drivers as partners, not just users. With AnyRide, you choose when to drive, how you earn, and what vehicle you use. Switch cars easily, cash out instantly, and grow your income without the usual pressure. Our system is built to support you — every step, every ride.

ourPromise.title: Take our words for it
ourPromise.description: We're creating something different — a ride-hailing experience that feels local, fair, and human. From our drivers who keep cities moving, to riders who trust us daily, AnyRide stands for safety, honesty, and empowerment. Because movement is freedom — and everyone deserves access to it. That's AnyRide. Built for people. Made for the move.

sections.title: Why do we use them?
sections.description: We use cookies to maintain your session, keep you logged in, remember your language settings, and understand which parts of our website are most popular so we can continue to improve AnyRide.

sections.title: Types of cookies we use

sections.title: Managing your cookies

definition.title: What Is a Fleet Owner?
definition.label: Fleet Owner
definition.description: A fleet owner on AnyRide is an individual or organization that operates multiple vehicles through the platform. Rather than driving themselves, fleet owners manage hired drivers who operate their vehicles to provide transportation services. Fleet ownership enables business-level operation of transportation services with centralized management tools, performance tracking, and consolidated financial reporting.

whoCanJoin.title: Who Can Join as a Fleet Owner?
whoCanJoin.item1Description: Operate and manage several taxis under a single, centralized platform.
whoCanJoin.item2Description: Run structured transport operations with coordinated vehicles and drivers.
whoCanJoin.item3Description: Scale ride services with better dispatch, monitoring, and payouts.
whoCanJoin.item4Description: Manage employee or organizational transport with scheduled, reliable operations.
whoCanJoin.item5Description: Deploy leased vehicles efficiently with tracked usage and performance.
whoCanJoin.item6Description: Operate driver-led vehicles as a structured, income-generating business.

benefits.title: Why Operate Your Fleet on AnyRide
benefits.item1Description: Monitor all vehicles, drivers, and operations from a single management interface.
benefits.item2Description: Track individual driver metrics, ratings, and activity across your fleet.
benefits.item3Description: Receive consolidated financial reports and automated payout processing.
benefits.item4Description: Maximize vehicle usage and earning potential through efficient driver assignment.
benefits.item5Description: Grow your fleet efficiently with tools designed for multi-vehicle management.
benefits.item6Description: Minimize administrative overhead with platform-managed scheduling and dispatch.

tools.title: Fleet Owner Tools & Capabilities
tools.feature1Description: Real-time view of all vehicles, active drivers, and current operations across your fleet.
tools.feature2Description: Add, remove, and manage vehicle profiles with registration and compliance tracking.
tools.feature3Description: Assign and reassign drivers to vehicles with flexible scheduling capabilities.
tools.feature4Description: Consolidated financial reporting showing earnings by vehicle, driver, and time period.
tools.feature5Description: Track key metrics including utilization rates, driver ratings, and fleet efficiency.
tools.feature6Description: Direct access to fleet owner support team for operational assistance.

howItWorks.title: How Fleet Operations Work
howItWorks.step1Description: Submit your fleet owner application with business and vehicle information.
howItWorks.step2Description: Register your vehicles and assign qualified drivers to each vehicle.
howItWorks.step3Description: Monitor rides, earnings, driver performance, and vehicle utilization in real time.
howItWorks.step4Description: Get consolidated earnings reports and automated payouts for all fleet activity.

earnings.title: Earnings & Business Control
earnings.description: As a fleet owner, you maintain full control over your business structure, driver agreements, and revenue sharing arrangements. AnyRide provides the platform infrastructure and tools to manage operations, while you determine how to structure your fleet business.
